force.label: Force
force.name: Force name
force.validation.nameTooLong: Force name must be 64 characters or fewer
force.validation.duplicate: A force with the same name already exists
image.invalidType: Select a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.
image.tooLarge: Image files must be 10 MB or smaller.
image.adjustHint: Adjust the position and zoom after selecting an image.
image.iconHelp: The bright circle is the visible icon area. Drag, use the arrow keys, or use the move buttons to adjust the position.
image.mapHelp: Drag, use the arrow keys, or use the move buttons to adjust the position, then set the zoom.
selected.help: Click the canvas to switch between a unit and a character. Only one can be selected at a time.
canvas.label: Battlefield view. Use arrow keys to pan, plus and minus to zoom, and Home or 0 to reset the view.
creator.editorLabel: Battlefield editor. Select an element from the element panel, then click this area to place it.
creator.timelineHelp: Placement time is the appearance time. You can also select an element type and click the battlefield to place it. Destroyed elements fade out over 0.5 seconds.
creator.validationPreview: Some placed elements have missing required fields and are outlined in red. Incomplete elements are omitted from the JSON preview.
creator.validationSave: Some placed elements have missing required fields. Complete the required fields or remove those elements before saving.
creator.hierarchyHelp: Use drag and drop to build Legion → Corps → Division → Regiment → Unit relationships. Characters remain directly under the battle. Drop an item on the battle title to remove its parent relationship.
creator.parentInvalid: The parent must be an ID of type {type}.
creator.parentHelp: Parent selection, hierarchy drag-and-drop, and manual input stay synchronized.
creator.groupMoveHelp: On/off changes are recorded at the current time and preserve the earlier path. Descendants follow the highest enabled ancestor. Explicit individual paths take priority, and after the last individual keyframe the element can continue following parent displacement.
creator.cameraZoomHelp: The red camera frame expands or contracts according to zoom.
creator.destroyHelp: The element fades out for 0.5 seconds from the specified time, then becomes hidden.
creator.palette.unit: Place the smallest moving combat element, such as an infantry unit, vehicle, or aircraft.
creator.palette.character: Place an independent character such as a commander.
creator.palette.legion: Place the top-level formation that contains the entire force structure.
creator.palette.corps: Place a corps under a legion.
creator.palette.division: Place a division under a corps.
creator.palette.regiment: Place a regiment that groups units under a division.
creator.palette.camera: Place a camera keyframe that defines the viewport center and zoom. The red rectangle shows the current frame.
canvas.touchHelp: Battlefield view. Drag with a finger or mouse to pan, pinch with two fingers or use the mouse wheel to zoom. Keyboard controls remain available with arrow keys, plus/minus, Home, or 0.
creator.descriptionPlaceholder: Add background, role, or flavor text for this element
creator.descriptionHelp: Optional. This text is exported to JSON and shown read-only in the viewer.
creator.importForceMissingColor: Force(s) "{names}" do not exist in Battle Hub and the JSON does not include a color that can be used to register them.
p2p.title: P2P distributed sharing
p2p.webOnly: P2P sharing is available only in the Battle Viewer Desktop app. On the web, use metadata browsing and local JSON import instead.
p2p.phase2Notice: This phase prepares persistent settings and the local cache only. No peer listener or network transfer is started yet.
p2p.unavailable: P2P settings are unavailable in this environment.
p2p.privacyIp: During P2P connections, your IP address may be visible to an authorized peer you connect to.
p2p.privacyDisk: If you consent to replication, the app may use disk space up to your configured cache limit.
p2p.privacyUpload: If you consent to redistribution, serving copies to other users will use upload bandwidth. Future transfers are designed to require fresh Hub authorization.
p2p.participationHelp: Allow P2P networking. Disabling prevents distribution and fetching.
p2p.downloadHelp: Allow fetching works from providers. Your IP may be visible to peers.
p2p.redistributionHelp: Serve validated cached works to authorized peers when enabled.
p2p.networkDescription: Manage network connection, storage and transfer limits. P2P joins automatically after your initial agreement, and can be changed here at any time.
p2p.ipHelp: Normally leave this blank for automatic address detection using the OS network route. WSL, VPN, NAT and firewall configurations may still require a manually reachable IPv4.
p2p.catalogDescription: The Hub stores metadata only. Content is downloaded from consenting peer devices.
p2p.startFirst: To download or publish distributed works, enable participation and start networking on Home.
hubPublish.title: Publish a work
hubPublish.drop: Drag and drop a Battle JSON file
hubPublish.invalid: The Battle JSON structure is invalid.
hubPublish.titleRequired: A work title of 1–200 characters is required.
hubPublish.duplicate: This JSON has already been published.
hubTerms.title: Battle Hub terms and network consent
hubTerms.intro: Review these network and sharing terms before your first visit to Battle Hub. No work catalog requests will be sent until you agree.
hubTerms.metadata: Battle Hub manages work metadata, including titles, descriptions, authors and distribution status.
hubTerms.p2p: Works are transferred directly between participating Battle Viewer clients over encrypted P2P connections. Shared works are stored on participating devices and may be unavailable while providers are offline.
hubTerms.privacy: P2P peers may see your IP address. Redistribution uses local disk space and upload bandwidth. Firewalls, NAT and network settings may prevent connections.
hubTerms.optional: By agreeing, P2P participation, downloading, and redistribution are enabled initially, with automatic connection when visiting Battle Hub. You can disable or adjust them later in Settings.
hubTerms.checkbox: I agree to these terms, including P2P participation, downloading and redistribution
hub.networkWarning: Could not start P2P. Check your address in Settings
